name: Gaiomon
main_effect:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
[When Digivolving] If this Digimon has a black digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. If this Digimon has a red digivolution card, ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.)
